text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And we've reached the halfway mark of the race!
The girls in the middle pack are keeping a close watch on the frontrunners!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To aim for the top with Nakayama Festa,
she'll need quick-witted adaptability on the fly
in addition to her raw strength and stamina.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How much she has grown since her Junior Class days,
and how much further growth we can expect from here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I can't afford to miss a single move in the race.
But as they rounded the third corner—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —An opening appeared in Nakayama Festa's guard.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haa... *gasp*,
...haa... *gasp*.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (...What was that just now?)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(It's not like my legs were hurting.
And yet, somehow—)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (—It's cold.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later, just to be safe,
we had the academy doctor examine her, but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Nothing out of the ordinary, huh.
choice_data_list: Thank goodness you didn't get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Getting injured at a time like this
would be like throwing away the Classics."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, how was the other day's race?
Are we going this year? —To the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
choice_data_list: Can I be honest with you?
Can I be honest?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...That answer's plenty.
In other words, you're not ready "yet."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Yes, her abilities still have room to grow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When entering a tournament with a fixed date,
athletes structure their peak training periods and conditioning routines to match that schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, traveling for overseas races
will require meticulous adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All we can do is race-specific training.
On top of that, rest days will have to align with the event schedule. But—
choice_data_list: It's still too early to set a ceiling on your potential.
It's far too early to set a limit on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "She ought to cultivate it through competing more with domestic Umamusume. For example—"
choice_data_list: Maybe we could use the Classic Triple Crown as an opportunity to grow and such.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
..."The Classic Triple Crown".
......Oh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A stage you can only challenge once in a lifetime, like the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho...
As a chance for growth?
choice_data_list: I think it'll provide just the right amount of tension for you.
I think it'll be just the right amount of tension for you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Whoa now,
calling the Classic Triple Crown 'just right' is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whoa, your... wait, no, it's mine? Just who could—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —...? Sensei's old man?

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
""Ah, Festa. Glad you picked up.
Sorry for the sudden call, but... um...""

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Every time my daughter was hospitalized, um...
...you always brought flowers to visit her, right?
So..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...? You're beating around the bush.
What're you trying to say, Pops?"

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
""Ah... You're right. My apologies.
Anyway...""

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text: “――...Could you come to the hospital?”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Sensei?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon reaching the hospital room,
Nakayama Festa's mentor gave a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both arms visible from the sleeves of her hospital pajamas
were considerably thinner
than when I saw her last autumn.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming, Festa.
And you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Even though I contacted you out of the blue,
thank you so much for granting my selfish request.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec, Doc.
Looking at you, there seem to be way more tubes than usual—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Listen, Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: I have less than a year left.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it all along.
That she didn't have much time left."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
All this diagnosis did was make that time limit clear.
That is all there is to it.
choice_data_list: The time limit is...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: I feel like thinking about it that way is a much better use of my time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Rather than struggling in vain,
I want to burn through this final light to the very end
so that no regrets remain.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, with the state my body is in,
it wouldn't be surprising if I were gone today,
or even tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't talk so weakly.
Be like you always are—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Festa.
I know my own body better than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It may have been a short life,
but being able to guide you as your teacher
was my greatest pride.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
So you can't come here anymore.
Don't look back—just keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...I just don't want you to see me
becoming less and less like the teacher
you know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But still! I made a promise
with Sensei the other day, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to show them what I look like when I conquer the world.
I wanted to show them what lies at the end of the life I've lived...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Yes. I really wanted to see it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...No, Sensei.
It's not... that I just wanted to see it...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: At least tell me you'll watch...

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Festa.
I'm sorry for making such a sudden demand.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Can the doctor really not save them...?
――Do we really have to give up?

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...She's been fighting
an illness for quite a while now, after all."

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she's grown a little tired.
Maybe she just wants to rest, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Kh, that can't be true!
If there was even a 1% chance, Sensei would...!
choice_data_list: ...Nakayama, wait.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!?
Outsiders need to butt out—
choice_data_list: Make sure you look the other person in the eye when you talk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The father of Nakayama Festa's former teacher
had red, swollen eyes and eyelids.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
He must have cried over and over.
...The person standing before me is just a father
who truly wants to wish for his daughter's happiness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Since when had her mentor
been conscious of their parting?"
choice_data_list: (Could everything she's said and done up until now also be...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's why, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Please, make the absolute most of her life... to the fullest.
choice_data_list: (――To bring out Nakayama Festa's full potential.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "If I were to run in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe right now, is there any probability I'd take 1st place?"
choice_data_list: ...Right now?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
My teacher used to tell me back in the day.
She said Paris and operas are full of romance.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, how about it?
If I were to run right now.
...Could I win?
choice_data_list: That is...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Guess it's "not yet" after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then right now, even if I tell her I'm aiming for it,
it won't spark a single shred of energy in Sensei, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
......Heh.
Hahaha......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, my mind went completely blank.
An unplanned event, a sudden occurrence.
What on earth were we supposed to do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what to do, or what the right answer is.
I don't know, I really don't. And yet—
choice_data_list: ...Hey, Nakayama.
……Hey, Nakayama

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: If there's a bet you want to make, just let me know properly.
If there's a bet you want to make, just let me know properly.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: If it's your gamble, I'll see it through with you to the end.
If it's your gamble, I'll stick with you till the very end.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: If that's what lets your strengths shine...
If that's what brings out the best in you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The initial feelings I held when I first teamed up with her
have not wavered even now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Let them live, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Because I truly believe 'hope keeps people going.'

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaah—...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. Do you people even understand
the meaning of the words you said to me?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Brace yourselves, you soft-hearted fools.
